commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+5' David Torres (Valladolid) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+1' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Peque and he is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla).
90+1' Substitution. Valentin Barco leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kike Salas (Sevilla).
90+1' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Peque (Sevilla) receives a yellow card!
90' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and Marcao (Sevilla) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
86' Today's match ends for Stanko Juric who will be replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
85' 2 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:1.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stanko Juric (Valladolid) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Sevilla take the free kick with a short pass.
80' Juan Pulido interrupts the game. One of the players from Valladolid won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
78' The game is interrupted. Marcao (Sevilla) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) is replacing Marcos Andre.
69' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' The resulting set piece from Valladolid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Booking. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives a caution from the referee.

65' That didn't go as planned! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Karl Hein, who easily kept it out.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
62' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Suso (Sevilla) replaces Kelechi Iheanacho.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jesus Navas walks off the pitch to be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
60' Juan Pulido blows his whistle. Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
59' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

59' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the top right corner, but Orjan Nyland is alert and thwarts the effort. The ball is out of play. Valladolid will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul Moro (Valladolid) replacing Darwin Machis.
57' It's time for a substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) comes on in place of Kike Perez.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Kike Perez (Valladolid) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Orjan Nyland. He makes it 1:1.
53' The game has come to an end for Saul Niguez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
51' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sevilla is cautioned for aggressive play.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
46' Paulo Pezzolano has made a change at the break. Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) has come on in place of Amath Ndiaye.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Juan Pulido sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+1' Wait! Referee Juan Pulido has indicated he is going to review the Sevilla goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45' Own goal! David Torres (Valladolid) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:0.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Sevilla are ruled offside.
39' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
37' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
33' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Marcos Andre (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
30' Sevilla concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
27' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Juan Pulido blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
26' The free kick from long range, taken by Valladolid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sevilla was in an offside position.
21' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
21' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
21' Referee Juan Pulido signals NO PENALTY for Sevilla after a VAR review!

20' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
18' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
17' The Valladolid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Karl Hein (Valladolid).
13' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Karl Hein scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
9' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Paulo Pezzolano appears to have said too much and referee Juan Pulido comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
5' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
3' Juan Pulido interrupts the game. One of the players from Sevilla won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Valentin Barco (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Juan Pulido blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Valladolid will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will referee today's match.
